# CLI reference

Generated for pachifast **0.15.0**.

Run `pachifast <command> --help` for the same information in the terminal. Commands that read a project accept `--base-dir` (the project root, default `.`).

## `pachifast audit`

Maintain the activity log of the project.

### `pachifast audit purge`

Delete the activity log rows older than the retention. Run it from cron or a systemd timer.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing .env and project_modules.py. | `.` |
| `--days` | Keep this many days (default: activity_log_retention_days). |  |
| `--dry-run` | Only count the rows that would be deleted. |  |

## `pachifast config`

Tools for the pachifast.yaml configuration file.

### `pachifast config schema`

Print (or write) the JSON Schema of pachifast.yaml, for completion and validation in the editor.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--output`, `-o` | Write the schema to this file instead of printing it. |  |

## `pachifast dev`

Run a generated project with uvicorn reload enabled.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing main.py. | `.` |
| `--app` | ASGI app import string. | `main:app` |
| `--host` | Bind host (default: config, else 127.0.0.1). |  |
| `--port` | Bind port (default: config, else 8000). |  |

## `pachifast init`

Prepare a generated project: .env, database migrations and first superuser.

Safe to run again: existing .env values, migrations and users are left untouched.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing project_modules.py. | `.` |
| `--username`, `-u` | Superuser username. | `admin` |
| `--password` | Superuser password (prompted if omitted). |  |
| `--email` | Superuser email. |  |
| `--database-url` | Auth database URL (default: SQLite file db.sqlite3 in the project). |  |
| `--target-name` | Migration target of the auth tables. | `auth` |
| `--no-user` | Do not create the superuser. |  |

## `pachifast locale`

Check the message catalogs and export them for the frontend.

### `pachifast locale admin`

List the texts of the model admin schema that a catalog can translate, and which languages have them.

The key is ``admin.<app>.<model>.title``, ``.<column>.label``, ``.<column>.options.<value>`` or
``.actions.<name>.label``. A text with no entry
keeps the default written in the code.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing project_modules.py. | `.` |
| `--missing` | Only the texts that some language does not translate. |  |

### `pachifast locale check`

Check the catalogs of the core, the modules and the project: same codes and fields in every language.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing project_modules.py. | `.` |

### `pachifast locale export`

Export the messages as nested JSON for vue-i18n.

The files are generated: they are always overwritten and never read back. Keep the texts that end users
change in a separate override file merged after them, or in the project's locale/ directory.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dest-path` | Folder that receives one <language>.json per language. |  |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing project_modules.py. | `.` |
| `--namespace` | Wrap the messages in this dotted path, e.g. errors.codes. |  |
| `--top-level` | With --namespace: codes whose first part is this stay at the top of the file, not under the namespace (repeatable; default: settings, permissions, groups). Pass an empty value to wrap everything. |  |
| `--core`, `--no-core` | Include the messages of the pachifast core (default: yes). | `True` |
| `--check` | Write nothing; exit 1 if the files are missing or out of date (for CI). |  |

### `pachifast locale permissions`

List the permissions and groups of the auth database and which languages have a label for them.

The key is ``permissions.<codename>.label`` / ``groups.<name>.label``. An identifier that is not a valid key
(for example a group called "Billing admins") cannot be translated and is shown with a ``-``.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing project_modules.py. | `.` |
| `--missing` | Only the entries that some language does not translate. |  |

### `pachifast locale settings`

List the texts of the user settings schema that a catalog can translate, and which languages have them.

The key is ``settings.<section>.<field>.<label|properties.<name>|options.<value>>``. A text with no entry
keeps the default written in the code.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing project_modules.py. | `.` |
| `--missing` | Only the texts that some language does not translate. |  |

## `pachifast migrations`

Manage Alembic migrations for a generated project.

### `pachifast migrations downgrade`

Rollback migrations for a target.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `revision` | Revision to downgrade to, for example -1 or base. |  |
| `--target-name` | Migration target name. |  |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing project_modules.py. | `.` |

### `pachifast migrations init`

Create Alembic directories for migration targets.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing project_modules.py. | `.` |
| `--target-name` | Initialize only one migration target. |  |

### `pachifast migrations list`

List declared migration targets.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing project_modules.py. | `.` |

### `pachifast migrations revision`

Create a new Alembic revision.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | Revision message. |  |
| `--target-name` | Migration target name. |  |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing project_modules.py. | `.` |
| `--autogenerate` | Generate migration operations from the models' metadata. |  |

### `pachifast migrations strip-sqlmodel`

Remove the SQLModel imports and types from the existing revision files (upgrade from 0.1.x).

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing project_modules.py. | `.` |
| `--check` | Only list the files that need the change (exit 1 if any). |  |

### `pachifast migrations upgrade`

Apply migrations for a target.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--target-name` | Migration target name. |  |
| `revision` (optional) | Revision to upgrade to. | `head` |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing project_modules.py. | `.` |

## `pachifast new`

Create a project, app, or common module.

### `pachifast new app`

Create a new app module in an existing project.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | App module name. |  |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing project_modules.py. | `.` |
| `--with-db` | Create settings and models scaffolding for a dedicated database target. |  |
| `--no-register` | Create files without updating project_modules.py. |  |

### `pachifast new common`

Create a new common module in an existing project.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Common module name. |  |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing project_modules.py. | `.` |
| `--with-db` | Create settings and models scaffolding for a dedicated database target. |  |
| `--no-register` | Create files without updating project_modules.py. |  |

### `pachifast new pipeline`

Generate the Dockerfile, .dockerignore and the CI pipeline (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI and/or Gitea Actions).

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing project_modules.py. | `.` |
| `--provider` | CI provider to generate the pipeline for. | `Provider.ALL` |
| `--python-version` | Python version (major.minor) of the base image. | `3.12` |
| `--force` | Overwrite files that already exist. |  |
| `--index-name` | Name of a private uv index declared in pyproject.toml ([[tool.uv.index]]), e.g. a Gitea registry: its credentials are passed to the build as secrets (UV_INDEX_USERNAME / UV_INDEX_PASSWORD). |  |
| `--ca-cert` | Path inside the project of the certificate authority (.crt/.pem) used by the private index's server, e.g. certs/internal-ca.crt: the image build trusts it. Public certificate, not a secret. |  |

### `pachifast new project`

Create a new project skeleton.

Interactive mode asks for the pyproject.toml properties that were not passed as options.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Project name. |  |
| `--output-dir` | Directory where the project will be created. | `.` |
| `--project-version` | Project version. |  |
| `--description`, `-d` | One-line description. |  |
| `--requires-python` | Python version specifier (default: >=3.11). |  |
| `--author` | Author name. |  |
| `--author-email` | Author email. |  |
| `--license` | SPDX license expression, e.g. MIT or Apache-2.0. |  |
| `--keyword`, `-k` | Keyword (repeat the option for more). |  |
| `--homepage` | Homepage URL. |  |
| `--repository` | Source repository URL. |  |
| `--package`, `-p` | Runtime dependency, e.g. 'httpx>=0.27' (repeat for more). |  |
| `--dev-package` | Development dependency, e.g. 'pytest' (repeat for more). |  |
| `--interactive`, `--no-interactive` | Ask for the pyproject properties not given as options (default: only when running in a terminal). --no-interactive uses the options and defaults. |  |
| `--git`, `--no-git` | Run git init in the new project and set the author as its local git user.name/user.email (only values not already set locally). | `True` |

## `pachifast serve`

Run the project for production: no reload, multiple workers, proxy headers.

Host and port come from the options, else from PACHIFAST_HOST/PACHIFAST_PORT, .env or the YAML file.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing main.py. | `.` |
| `--app` | ASGI app import string. | `main:app` |
| `--host` | Bind host (default: config, else 127.0.0.1). |  |
| `--port` | Bind port (default: config, else 8000). |  |
| `--workers` | Number of worker processes. | `1` |
| `--proxy-headers`, `--no-proxy-headers` | Trust X-Forwarded-For/-Proto headers, from the addresses in --forwarded-allow-ips only. | `True` |
| `--forwarded-allow-ips` | Comma separated IPs allowed to send proxy headers. Default: uvicorn's (127.0.0.1 only, or the FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS variable). Use '*' only when the server is reachable through the proxy alone. |  |
| `--log-level` | Log level: critical, error, warning, info, debug, trace. | `info` |

## `pachifast users`

Manage auth users in the configured authentication database.

### `pachifast users create`

Create a new auth user.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | Username for the new user. |  |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing .env and project_modules.py. | `.` |
| `--password` | Plain-text password. If omitted, it is prompted. |  |
| `--email` | Email address. |  |
| `--first-name` | First name. |  |
| `--last-name` | Last name. |  |
| `--staff` | Create the user with is_staff=true. |  |
| `--superuser` | Create the user with is_superuser=true. |  |
| `--inactive` | Create the user with is_active=false. |  |
| `--force` | Bypass the password length policy. |  |

### `pachifast users delete`

Delete an auth user and the data linked to it (groups, permissions, settings, MFA). It cannot be undone.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | Username of the user to delete. |  |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing .env and project_modules.py. | `.` |
| `--yes`, `-y` | Do not ask for confirmation. |  |

### `pachifast users encrypt-mfa-secrets`

Encrypt the TOTP secrets stored as plain text (rows written before 0.10). Safe to run again.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing .env and project_modules.py. | `.` |

### `pachifast users ls`

List auth users, optionally filtered.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` (optional) | Substring filter on username or email (case-insensitive). |  |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing .env and project_modules.py. | `.` |

### `pachifast users update`

Update an existing auth user.

| Argument / option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | Username of the user to update. |  |
| `--base-dir` | Project root containing .env and project_modules.py. | `.` |
| `--password` | New plain-text password (see password_min_length and --force). |  |
| `--prompt-password`, `-P` | Prompt for the new password. |  |
| `--email` | New email address. |  |
| `--first-name` | New first name. |  |
| `--last-name` | New last name. |  |
| `--staff`, `--no-staff` | Set is_staff flag. |  |
| `--superuser`, `--no-superuser` | Set is_superuser flag. |  |
| `--active`, `--no-active` | Set is_active flag. |  |
| `--force` | Bypass the password length policy. |  |
